notes: batch-0348 (maintenance, 2026-11-11, parent batch-0347=676f3d292a0). Manifest + tool maintenance batch (the payload grew mid-review from manifest-only to include the S6 gate; see the process note below). The cumulative scope declaration (src/tools/zh-tools/manifests/cumulative.json, batch_id 'cumulative') had not been regenerated since batch-0259 (a57a7470fb1): all 88 batches from 0260 through 0347 landed without updating it, so the default (non-incremental) check_scope mode was silently stale. Regeneration: git diff --name-status against the frozen REL_16_11 base = 1212 changed paths (739 M / 473 A); 995 entries reused from the previous file (kind/note/segments preserved, action refreshed), 217 fresh entries for post-0259 paths (new batch manifests 0320-0347, new tool/test files, newly translated .c/.h; inferred kind, terse note); c_comment 498->622, manifest 306->396 (395 in the 1212-census framing + this batch's own manifest entry), total 1213 files entries including this batch's own manifest. base_commit/pgnls_commit unchanged. parent_commit set to HEAD (informational; the cumulative mode diffs against base_commit). Validation: check_scope default cumulative mode --worktree . --manifest cumulative.json = PASS, 1213 changed paths, 0 violations (first runnable since 0259); --incremental runs caveated: the batch-0347-manifest re-run quoted here only holds in a worktree without 0348's paths staged (expected S2_OUTSIDE_MANIFEST otherwise); tests 229 = 222 + 7 documented ScopeEndToEnd umask failures (the +1 is this batch's CumulativeRegistrationUnit; an earlier revision said 228 = 221 + 7 pre-commit - superseded). Tool change (same commit as first use): check_scope gains the S6 cumulative-registration check in --incremental mode - every changed path must have a files[] entry in the sibling cumulative.json whose action matches its base-relative status (add if absent at the frozen base, modify otherwise; --cumulative to point elsewhere or 'skip' to opt out), so the cumulative declaration can no longer rot silently; TOOLS_VERSION 0.2.4 -> 0.2.5; CumulativeRegistrationUnit unit test added (happy path, wrong action, missing entry). Going forward every batch appends its manifest path (and any new tool paths) to cumulative.json in the same commit - standing gate item recorded in the campaign memory; periodic full regeneration only if drift is suspected. Process note (recorded by batch-0349): this file's original notes opened with 'No .c/.h changes - manifest-only maintenance' and claimed 'tests 228 = 221 + 7 (no tool change)' while the batch payload had grown to include the S6 gate (check_scope.py +47, tests +92, TOOLS_VERSION 0.2.5) mid-review; the R1R2 review correctly FAILed the mutated state and the commit landed before its verdict. Batch-0349 corrects these notes to the single consistent story above and adds the missing EOF newline. The shipped S6 change itself passed a dedicated post-commit content review (verdict PASS: base-relative probe anchored to the frozen base is the correct semantic, negatives S6_CUMULATIVE_MISSING / S6_CUMULATIVE_ACTION exercised through the real code path, disclosed limitations: silent auto-skip when no sibling cumulative.json exists, deleted-then-re-added-identical edge, no S1-style base check on the declaration itself; optional helper refactor for the unit test deferred to a future tools batch).
